# ARKA Constructions

> ARKA Constructions is a construction company based in Maraimalai Nagar, Chengalpattu, serving Chennai and nearby areas with residential, commercial, industrial and civil construction services.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://arkaconstruction.in/): Company overview, approach, services, projects, packages and contact details.
- [Services](https://arkaconstruction.in/services/): Civil and RCC, earthworks, flooring, fabrication, glazing, pavers, painting, plumbing, roads, waterproofing, demolition, maintenance and industrial works.
- [Projects](https://arkaconstruction.in/projects/): Completed and ongoing construction work.
- [Packages](https://arkaconstruction.in/packages/): Home construction packages from ₹2,449 per sq ft, starting at 1,200 sq ft.
